title: Attribution Ledger Entry
description: One NDJSON line in an engagement-scoped attribution ledger. Records who/what performed an action against a repository, out-of-band of that repository. Session binding (sid/jti/token_hash) is optional; proof and prev are reserved (null-valid) for hash-chain tamper-evidence and per-record attestation. No floating-point fields (JCS-safe for future proof attachment).

sha256-digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest with 'sha256:' prefix.

session-claims.description: Verified session claims from an in-process lanyte-attest verify. All three fields required when session is present.

sid.description: Session id from the attestation token (JWT sid claim).

jti.description: Token id from the attestation token (JWT jti claim).

token_hash.description: sha256 of the raw session token bytes (never store the raw token).

ts.description: UTC timestamp when the ledger entry was written.

engagement.description: Engagement codename from LANYTE_ENGAGEMENT at write time. Present when env provides it; empty or omitted only in synthetic fixtures.

repo.description: Repository basename (not a full path) of the target work tree.

branch.description: Branch name at the time of the action (may be '?' if unresolved).

hash.description: Git object hash for the action (commit SHA). Short or full.

remote.description: origin remote URL if configured; empty string when absent.

git_host.description: Engagement-configured git host label (from foundation env); empty when unset.

subject.description: Commit subject line (first line of message) when available.

maintainer_handle.description: Engagement maintainer handle from foundation env; empty when unset.

agent_role.description: LANYTE_AGENT_ROLE at write time; empty when unset.

agent_team.description: LANYTE_AGENT_TEAM at write time; empty when unset.

agent_scope.description: LANYTE_AGENT_SCOPE at write time; empty when unset.

note.description: Optional free-text note supplied by the operator.

session.description: Verified session binding, or null when the entry is unattested (warn-mode or --unattested).

unattested.description: True when the entry was explicitly written with --unattested under a trust-rooted machine. Distinct from warn-mode session:null (no trust root).

proof.description: Reserved for per-record attestation proof (detached JWS compact). Null-valid in v0; no new crypto ships with this schema version.

prev.description: sha256 of the previous entry's canonical bytes (JCS of the entry with proof excluded). Null for the first entry in a ledger file.
